notes: ACTi cameras expose RTSP streams at /stream<N> (1-based: /stream1 = main, /stream2 = sub, up to /stream4 on some models). The RTSP access name is user-configurable in the camera web UI (Streaming > RTSP > Access Name); /stream1 is the typical factory default observed in ACTi's own VLC guide. Default RTSP port is 554 per the current firmware manual. Port 7070 documented in the older ACTi Streaming Explorer tool (2011) is ACTi's proprietary SDK streaming protocol port — not standard RTSP. Cameras supporting up to 4 streams use /stream1–/stream4. ACTi is a Taiwanese manufacturer (acti.com), not an OEM of Dahua or Hikvision.
